prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production sprite seed atlas for a monochrome 2D creature-collecting handheld RPG, later reduced to a 128x64 display. New original sprites without image references.
Composition: exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows, SIXTEEN separate isolated assets, generous fully transparent gutters. Every asset sits on the same baseline as others in its row. Each sprite must be one connected opaque silhouette including opaque white interiors, on genuine transparency. This is a SPRITE SHEET, not a landscape or assembled scene. Use consistent classic overhead RPG perspective with front-facing vertical surfaces, never isometric. No grid lines, no text, no labels, no characters, no shadows detached from sprites.
Palette: only opaque black, opaque white, and a small amount of flat #999999 for material undersides. Hard pixel steps, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no dithering, no tiny hatching.
EXACT row-major asset order (native design sizes; draw larger using clean chunky steps):
ROW 1: (1) scree ground swatch, 16x16, PALE sparse rock flecks, fully opaque borderless square, no frame; (2) marsh mud ground swatch, 16x16, pale gray mud with a few dark ripple/fissure marks, opaque borderless square; (3) snow ground swatch,16x16, almost white with two or three small dark wind marks, opaque borderless square; (4) basalt ground swatch,16x16, mostly BLACK interlocking volcanic plates with a few white fractures, opaque borderless square.
ROW 2: (5) molten lava ground swatch,16x16, mostly WHITE glowing flow with sparse black looping crust marks, opaque borderless square; (6) frozen ice ground swatch,16x16, white with a few long clean diagonal black cracks, opaque borderless square; (7) ancient stone courtyard ground swatch,16x16, pale irregular large worn flagstones with black joints, opaque borderless square; (8) marsh water swatch,16x16, black water with sparse white horizontal ripple cuts and small gray pools, opaque borderless square.
ROW 3: (9) reusable mountain cliff face block,32x32, flat horizontal light rocky top ledge, clearly darker vertical crag face below, straight left/right edges so copies can meet; transparent outside the rock silhouette; (10) short stone staircase,16x32, six broad white horizontal treads with black risers, straight sides and same width throughout, transparent outside; (11) ancient broken stone archway,48x48, two stout masonry piers and a chipped curved lintel, large fully transparent opening, opaque white stone interiors; (12) solitary broken stone column,16x32, damaged shaft with simple plinth, opaque white stone on transparency.
ROW 4: (13) snow-covered pine tree,32x48, dark stepped branches with chunky white snow caps, visible short trunk at bottom; (14) leafless marsh tree,32x32, thick dark crooked trunk, bare chunky branches with white cuts, no detached pieces; (15) volcanic steam vent rock,32x32, squat black basalt cone around bright white crater, two short steam wisps connected to crater; (16) low ancient ruined wall,32x16, pale crumbling stone masonry with broken top edge, straight base, transparent outside. Keep every prop on a single connected silhouette.
All source swatches are reusable, not little scenes. No tile frames. Transparent background.
Style direction: Ink silhouettes direction: bold black silhouette masses with deliberate large white negative-space cuts, crisp angular pixel steps and restrained gray. Pale walkable terrain and snow against dark trees and rocks; basalt and marsh water stay dark.
